<section id="section-progression" class="bg-beige section-padding">
  <div class="aws-container">
    <div class="editorial-2col">
      <div class="editorial-text">
        <div class="aws-divider"></div>
        <h2 style="text-align:left !important;">Can you learn kitesurfing in one week?</h2>
        <p>Yes. Most beginners learn the fundamentals in 5 days of instruction at Algarve Watersport. The key is building kite control first. Once you can fly the kite confidently, the board skills come together much faster. The Wake Park session on Tuesday is a deliberate part of the program: you learn the water start motion on a cable without having to control a kite at the same time. When you combine both skills on the water, it clicks.</p>

        <div class="progression reveal">
          <h4>Day 1. Safety, setup &amp; kite control</h4>
          <p>Full safety briefing, how the wind works, kite setup, and your first kite flying. The entire focus is building confidence and control. Possibly first body drags by end of day.</p>

          <h4>Day 2. Body dragging</h4>
          <p>The kite pulls you through the water in different directions. You learn how to generate power where you want it. By end of day 2, first water start attempts are possible.</p>

          <h4>Day 3. Water starts + Wake Park</h4>
          <p>The board arrives. First water start attempts in the lagoon. The Wake Park session teaches you to get up on a board behind a cable. The same motion as a kite water start, without the kite.</p>

          <h4>Days 4-5. Riding</h4>
          <p>Once water starts click, the focus shifts to riding, board control, and building distance. Most students have had water starts and some riding by day 5. Individual progression varies.</p>
        </div>

        <div class="multi-sport-box reveal">
          <strong>Realistic expectation:</strong>
          The first 2-3 days are all about kite control. That&#8217;s the foundation that makes everything else possible. Once control is solid, the board skills come together fast.
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="editorial-sidebar">
        <div class="progression-gallery">
          <img decoding="async" src="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20600%20400'%3E%3C/svg%3E" alt="Kite group lesson with women at golden hour in Lagos Algarve" width="600" height="400" data-lazy-src="https://algarvewatersport.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/kitesurf-group-lesson-women-lagos-golden-hour.webp"><noscript><img decoding="async" src="https://algarvewatersport.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/kitesurf-group-lesson-women-lagos-golden-hour.webp" alt="Kite group lesson with women at golden hour in Lagos Algarve" loading="lazy" width="600" height="400"></noscript>
          <img decoding="async" src="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20600%20400'%3E%3C/svg%3E" alt="Kite instructor and student during lesson in Algarve waters" width="600" height="400" style="object-position:center 70%;" data-lazy-src="https://algarvewatersport.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/kitesurf-instructor-student-lesson-algarve-water.webp"><noscript><img decoding="async" src="https://algarvewatersport.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/kitesurf-instructor-student-lesson-algarve-water.webp" alt="Kite instructor and student during lesson in Algarve waters" loading="lazy" width="600" height="400" style="object-position:center 70%;"></noscript>
          <img decoding="async" src="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20600%20400'%3E%3C/svg%3E" alt="Kite instructor helping student with water start in Algarve" width="600" height="400" data-lazy-src="https://algarvewatersport.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/kitesurf-lesson-mystic-instructor-waterstart.webp"><noscript><img decoding="async" src="https://algarvewatersport.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/kitesurf-lesson-mystic-instructor-waterstart.webp" alt="Kite instructor helping student with water start in Algarve" loading="lazy" width="600" height="400"></noscript>

<section class="bg-white section-padding">
  <div class="aws-container text-center">
    <div class="aws-divider"></div>
    <h2>Take your riding to the next level</h2>
    <p class="subtitle">Learn kitesurfing, do yoga every day, meet new kite friends, and relax in an all-in international watersport camp.</p>

    <div class="video-embed" style="max-width:80%;margin:0 auto 40px;">
      <div class="rll-youtube-player" data-src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/_2xBxevV9Lo" data-id="_2xBxevV9Lo" data-query="rel=0" data-alt="Algarve Watersport Kite Camp Video"></div><noscript><iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/_2xBxevV9Lo?rel=0" title="Algarve Watersport Kite Camp Video" loading="lazy" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture" allowfullscreen></iframe></noscript>
      <div class="video-embed-placeholder" style="pointer-events:none;">
        <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_2xBxevV9Lo" target="_blank" rel="noopener" style="pointer-events:auto;color:var(--aws-white);text-decoration:underline;font-size:14px;opacity:0.8;">Watch on YouTube if video doesn&#8217;t load</a>
      </div>
    </div>

    <p style="max-width:720px;margin:0 auto;color:var(--aws-gray);line-height:1.7;font-size:15px;">Every lesson is tailored to your level. Beginners build kite control first, then progress through body dragging and water starts toward the goal: riding independently upwind. Already riding? The Intermediate camp focuses on transitions, jumps, and strapless. Instructors use radios for real-time coaching on the water. Small groups (max 4) and semi-private sessions with your own kite mean you&#8217;re never waiting around.</p>
  </div>
</section>





<section id="section-spots" class="bg-white section-padding">
  <div class="aws-container">
    <div class="text-center">
      <div class="aws-divider"></div>
      <h2>Where do you kitesurf near Lagos?</h2>
      <p class="subtitle">Two spots, chosen daily based on wind and tide. Both are within 15 minutes of camp.</p>
    </div>

    <div class="spot-grid reveal">
      <div class="spot-card">
        <div class="spot-card-img">
          <img decoding="async" src="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20600%20338'%3E%3C/svg%3E" alt="Kites deployed at Ria de Alvor lagoon flat water spot near Lagos" width="600" height="338" data-lazy-src="https://algarvewatersport.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/kitesurf-north-kites-deployed-lagos-lagoon-wide.webp"><noscript><img decoding="async" src="https://algarvewatersport.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/kitesurf-north-kites-deployed-lagos-lagoon-wide.webp" alt="Kites deployed at Ria de Alvor lagoon flat water spot near Lagos" loading="lazy" width="600" height="338"></noscript>
        </div>
        <div class="spot-card-body">
          <h4>Ria de Alvor Lagoon</h4>
          <div class="spot-card-distance">15 min from camp. Primary kite spot</div>
          <p>A flat-water lagoon between Lagos and Alvor with a sandy bottom and a shallow sandbar where you can stand during lessons. The Nortada thermal wind blows side-offshore here, creating consistent, manageable conditions for learning. Most of your kite days will be spent here.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="spot-card">
        <div class="spot-card-img">
          <img decoding="async" src="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20600%20338'%3E%3C/svg%3E" alt="Kitesurf student riding at Meia Praia beach in Lagos Algarve" width="600" height="338" data-lazy-src="https://algarvewatersport.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/kitesurf-student-riding-atlantic-ocean-algarve.webp"><noscript><img decoding="async" src="https://algarvewatersport.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/kitesurf-student-riding-atlantic-ocean-algarve.webp" alt="Kitesurf student riding at Meia Praia beach in Lagos Algarve" loading="lazy" width="600" height="338"></noscript>
        </div>
        <div class="spot-card-body">
          <h4>Meia Praia Beach</h4>
          <div class="spot-card-distance">5 min from camp. Deep water sessions</div>
          <p>On days when tides don&#8217;t align with the lagoon&#8217;s teaching window, lessons move to Meia Praia for deep water sessions with boat support. The instructor gives a full briefing, students wear radios for constant communication, and the boat picks you up after each run.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section id="section-usp" class="bg-white section-padding">
  <div class="aws-container text-center">
    <div class="aws-divider"></div>
    <h2>What makes this kite camp different?</h2>
    <p class="subtitle">Most kite camps are kite-only. If the wind drops, you&#8217;re stuck. Here, that&#8217;s not even a consideration.</p>

    <div class="usp-grid reveal">
      <div class="usp-item">
        <div class="icon-circle">
          <img decoding="async" src="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%2070%2070'%3E%3C/svg%3E" alt="Multi-sport icon" width="70" height="70" data-lazy-src="https://algarvewatersport.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/icon-always-action.png"><noscript><img decoding="async" src="https://algarvewatersport.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/icon-always-action.png" alt="Multi-sport icon" width="70" height="70"></noscript>
        </div>
        <h5>No-wind activities</h5>
        <p>Switch to surf, wake, wingfoil, windsurf, or SUP on any day without wind. No wasted days.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="usp-item">
        <div class="icon-circle">
          <img decoding="async" src="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%2070%2070'%3E%3C/svg%3E" alt="VDWS license icon" width="70" height="70" data-lazy-src="https://algarvewatersport.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/icon-kite-canopy.png"><noscript><img decoding="async" src="https://algarvewatersport.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/icon-kite-canopy.png" alt="VDWS license icon" width="70" height="70"></noscript>
        </div>
        <h5>VDWS license included</h5>
        <p>Internationally recognized certification. Rent equipment at kite schools worldwide after your week.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="usp-item">
        <div class="icon-circle">
          <img decoding="async" src="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%2070%2070'%3E%3C/svg%3E" alt="Two kite spots icon" width="70" height="70" data-lazy-src="https://algarvewatersport.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/icon-super-spot.png"><noscript><img decoding="async" src="https://algarvewatersport.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/icon-super-spot.png" alt="Two kite spots icon" width="70" height="70"></noscript>
        </div>
        <h5>Two kite spots</h5>
        <p>Flat-water lagoon for learning, deep water sessions at Meia Praia. Spot chosen daily by conditions.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="usp-item">
        <div class="icon-circle">
          <img decoding="async" src="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%2070%2070'%3E%3C/svg%3E" alt="Wake park icon" width="70" height="70" data-lazy-src="https://algarvewatersport.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/icon-cable-park.png"><noscript><img decoding="async" src="https://algarvewatersport.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/icon-cable-park.png" alt="Wake park icon" width="70" height="70"></noscript>
        </div>
        <h5>Wake Park day</h5>
        <p>Tuesday cable session teaches board skills separately. When you combine both on the water, it clicks faster.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="usp-item">
        <div class="icon-circle">
          <img decoding="async" src="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%2070%2070'%3E%3C/svg%3E" alt="Camp shop icon" width="70" height="70" data-lazy-src="https://algarvewatersport.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/icon-shop-sale.png"><noscript><img decoding="async" src="https://algarvewatersport.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/03/icon-shop-sale.png" alt="Camp shop icon" width="70" height="70"></noscript>
        </div>
        <h5>Camp shop support</h5>
        <p>Buy gear with 10% camp discount. We support you from first lesson to your own setup. Not just teach and disappear.</p>
      </div>
    </div>

<section id="section-accommodation" class="bg-beige section-padding">
  <div class="aws-container">
    <h2>What&#8217;s the accommodation and food like in the kite camp?</h2>

    
    <div class="alt-block">
      <div class="alt-block-img">
        <img width="1400" height="933" decoding="async" src="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201400%20933'%3E%3C/svg%3E" alt="Dinner with broccoli stir fry, noodles and cucumber salad at Algarve Watersport camp" data-lazy-src="https://algarvewatersport.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/surf-camp-dinner-broccoli-stir-fry-noodles-cucumber-salad.webp"><noscript><img width="1400" height="933" decoding="async" src="https://algarvewatersport.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/surf-camp-dinner-broccoli-stir-fry-noodles-cucumber-salad.webp" alt="Dinner with broccoli stir fry, noodles and cucumber salad at Algarve Watersport camp" loading="lazy"></noscript>

      <div class="alt-block-text">
        <h3>The food, consistently the thing people rave about</h3>
        <p>Our chef team cooks fresh buffet meals every day. International variety with Portuguese touches. Breakfast runs 8:00 to 10:30. Dinner is served at communal tables where half the friendships at camp start.</p>
        <p>Vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free. Let us know when you book. Wednesday is all-you-can-eat pizza night at the Wake Park. Friday is your night to explore Lagos.</p>
        <ul class="check-list">
          <li>Daily breakfast + 6 dinners (inc. pizza night at the Wake Park)</li>
          <li>Dietary needs handled</li>
          <li>Lunch on your own. Pingo Doce supermarket 5 min walk</li>
        </ul>
      </div>
    </div>

The Couch of Happiness, where every day&#8217;s plans start and most friendships begin. 20+ nationalities every week, average age around 30. It&#8217;s social but never forced.</p>

            <h4>The Hill — Premium Twin Rooms</h4>
            <p>A private three-floor villa a four-minute drive from camp, with east-facing sunrise terraces, A/C and underfloor heating throughout. Twin-bed rooms with shared bathrooms — all meals, yoga, kite and transport still fully included. For guests who want a quiet, high-spec base without stepping outside the camp experience.</p>
            <div class="accom-panel-price">+&euro;125/person/week<br><small style="font-size:13px;font-weight:400;opacity:0.75;">Shared bathroom. All camp benefits included.</small></div>
            <ul class="check-list">
              <li>Twin bed configuration</li>
              <li>Shared bathroom</li>
              <li>A/C + underfloor heating</li>
              <li>Sunrise terrace</li>
              <li>4 minutes by car</li>
            </ul>
            <span class="accom-panel-tag">Premium option — quieter base, fully part of camp</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section id="section-faq" class="bg-beige section-padding">
  <div class="aws-container">
    <h2 class="text-center">Questions about the kite camp</h2>

    <div class="faq-list">

      <div class="faq-item open" data-faq-index="1">
        <button class="faq-question" aria-expanded="true" aria-controls="faq-1">
          Do I need experience to join a kite camp?
          
        </button>
        <div class="faq-answer" id="faq-1">
          <div class="faq-answer-inner"><p>No prior experience needed. The <a href="/en/booking/">Zero to Hero package</a> is designed for complete beginners — you start with kite control on the beach, progress to body dragging, and work toward water starts and riding. IKO and VDWS certified instructors guide every step. Maximum 4 students per group lesson. Not sure what to expect? The <a href="/en/kitesurfing-lessons-lagos/">beginner&#8217;s guide to kitesurfing lessons in Lagos</a> walks through the full day-by-day progression.</p></div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="faq-item open" data-faq-index="2">
        <button class="faq-question" aria-expanded="true" aria-controls="faq-2">
          Can you really learn kitesurfing in one week?
          
        </button>
        <div class="faq-answer" id="faq-2">
          <div class="faq-answer-inner"><p>Most beginners can learn the fundamentals in 5 days. Days 1-3 build kite control — the foundation. Days 4-5 focus on board, water starts, and riding. The Wake Park session accelerates this by teaching the board feel without kite complexity. By day 5, most students have water starts and some riding.</p></div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="faq-item open" data-faq-index="3">
        <button class="faq-question" aria-expanded="true" aria-controls="faq-3">
          What happens if there is no wind?
          
        </button>
        <div class="faq-answer" id="faq-3">
          <div class="faq-answer-inner"><p>You switch sports. Algarve Watersport is the only multi-sport camp in Lagos — on any no-wind day, you can <a href="/en/portugal-surf-camp/">surf</a>, wakeboard, try <a href="/en/wingfoiling-portugal/wingfoil-camp-portugal/">wingfoil</a>, windsurf, or go on a SUP tour. The team communicates forecasts the evening before.</p></div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="faq-item" data-faq-index="3b">
        <button class="faq-question" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-3b">
          What happens when the wind forecast is uncertain?
          
        </button>
        <div class="faq-answer" id="faq-3b">
          <div class="faq-answer-inner"><p>Your booking stays as normal. We update you one day in advance if the forecast looks uncertain and you can switch activities until the day before. On the day at the camp: if wind looks too unlikely, you can reschedule or switch to another activity. Your minimum spend still applies. At the lagoon: good wind means a full lesson; light wind means a shorter session focused on safety, theory and essential skills — you only pay for actual teaching time. If we cancel after arriving at the lagoon, a small instructor fee of €10 applies. We still run sessions in uncertain conditions because understanding wind, safety and conditions is a key part of becoming a confident kiter.</p></div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="faq-item open" data-faq-index="4">
        <button class="faq-question" aria-expanded="true" aria-controls="faq-4">
          I&#8217;ve kited before. Which camp should I join?
          
        </button>
        <div class="faq-answer" id="faq-4">
          <div class="faq-answer-inner"><p>The <a href="#section-pricing">Intermediate package</a>. Five semi-private sessions with your own kite, so you&#8217;re riding and improving the entire lesson. Our instructors teach everything from upwind riding to transitions, jumps, and even strapless riding. Every session is tailored to where you are right now. Radios keep you connected to the instructor on the water, so corrections happen in real time.</p></div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="faq-item" data-faq-index="6">
        <button class="faq-question" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-6">
          When is the best time for kitesurfing in the Algarve?
          
        </button>
        <div class="faq-answer" id="faq-4">
          <div class="faq-answer-inner"><p>June, July, and August — when the Nortada thermal wind blows consistently. In peak season, expect 3-5 wind days per week. April, September, and October are weather-dependent. For those months, book a <a href="/en/portugal-surf-camp/">surf camp</a> and upgrade to kiting if conditions allow.</p></div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="faq-item" data-faq-index="6">
        <button class="faq-question" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-6">
          What equipment is included?
          
        </button>
        <div class="faq-answer" id="faq-6">
          <div class="faq-answer-inner"><p>Everything: kite, board, harness, helmet, wetsuit, and impact vest. Algarve Watersport refreshes equipment regularly. Neoprene booties are available for purchase in the camp shop. All kite camp guests also receive 10% discount on gear in the shop.</p></div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="faq-item" data-faq-index="7">
        <button class="faq-question" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-7">
          Where do kite lessons take place?
          
        </button>
        <div class="faq-answer" id="faq-7">
          <div class="faq-answer-inner"><p>Most lessons at Ria de Alvor lagoon — a flat-water spot 15 minutes from camp with a sandy bottom. On days when tides don&#8217;t align, lessons move to Meia Praia beach (5 min from camp) for deep water sessions with boat support and radio communication.</p></div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="faq-item" data-faq-index="8">
        <button class="faq-question" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-8">
          Is the kite camp suitable for solo travelers?
          
        </button>
        <div class="faq-answer" id="faq-8">
          <div class="faq-answer-inner"><p>Absolutely. Around 51% of all Algarve Watersport guests travel solo. Average age about 30, 20+ countries each week. Communal meals and yoga create connections naturally.</p></div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="faq-item" data-faq-index="9">
        <button class="faq-question" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-9">
          What is the VDWS license?
          
        </button>
        <div class="faq-answer" id="faq-9">
          <div class="faq-answer-inner"><p>The VDWS (Verband Deutscher Wassersport Schulen) license is an internationally recognized kitesurfing certification included in all kite camp packages. You take a test and receive a card certifying your level — this lets you rent equipment at kite schools worldwide.</p></div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="faq-item" data-faq-index="10">
        <button class="faq-question" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-10">
          What is the difference between group and semi-private lessons?
          
        </button>
        <div class="faq-answer" id="faq-10">
          <div class="faq-answer-inner"><p>Group: max 4 students, 2 per kite, 3 hours. Semi-private: 2.5 hours with your own kite — no sharing. Zero to Hero combines both: 2 group for foundations, 3 semi-private once you have control.</p></div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="faq-item" data-faq-index="11">
        <button class="faq-question" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="faq-11">
          How do I get to Lagos?
          
        </button>
        <div class="faq-answer" id="faq-11">
          <div class="faq-answer-inner"><p>Faro Airport is about 70 km away — roughly 1 hour by car. We offer airport transfers for &euro;80 per booking (split between passengers). Buses and car rentals also available. See our <a href="/en/best-ways-to-get-to-lagos-portugal/">complete guide to getting to Lagos</a>.</p></div>
        </div>
      </div>

    </div>
  </div>
</section>
